description: List the customers - accounts that sign in to the user's site (records of an accounts model), with status, verification, last login, their company, companyRole (the effective company role: admin or buyer in v1, null without a company), effectivePriceList (the price list that prices them, source MEMBER or COMPANY; null = catalogue prices) and orderStats (non-canceled order count, last order date, and net spend = paid minus refunded, in minor units, one entry per currency; null when the caller may not view orders). Not the team: those are list_team. Read-only; filter by model, status, company or an identity search; newest first. Paginated: while hasMore is true, pass nextCursor back as cursor while it is set; if hasMore is true but nextCursor is null, page with the offset instead, and past offset 10000 narrow the filter.

companyId.description: Only customers linked to this company record

cursor.description: nextCursor from the previous page. The page continues after it in the same filter and sort; leave the skip/offset at 0 when you pass it

modelId.description: Only customers of this accounts model, by id or slug (from list_models)

search.description: Case-insensitive match against the sign-in identity (email)

skip.description: How many rows to skip, at most 10000; page past that with cursor

name: list_customers
title: List customers
